'''Threepwood''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he went to [[Juma 9]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to free the station of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]' [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

==Biography==
A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Callsign/Legends|nicknamed]] "Threepwood" was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and bred to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Threepwood served under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] in the Republic's [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]].

During the Clone Wars, sometime after the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], the enemy forces of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] learned of the existence of a powerful weapon that could destroy the Republic. The Republic learned of this too, and sent several Jedi with their clone forces to stop them.

Threepwood ventured with General [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to liberate the outpost [[Juma 9]] from the Separatists, in an attempt to learn more of this weapon. Threepwood took it upon himself to repair and guard the communications array of the station, as the Separatist droids had sabotaged it when the Republic attacked.<ref name="TCW RH DS edition" />

==Behind the scenes==
Threepwood's nickname is identical to the surname of [[Guybrush Threepkiller|Guybrush Threepwood]], the main protagonist of the [[Wikipedia:Monkey Island (series)|''Monkey Island'']] series of games, also created by [[LucasArts]].
